Quest Unlock: Egypt and Atlantis (part of the Atlantis quest chain)

To access, go to Ganador Command Center and speak to Spy. Click "Ancient Ganador Research Mission" button, and accept.

Ganador location:


Once defeated, this Ganador will never reappear, and it becomes possible to (randomly) access the following Ancient Ganadors:

Dictator Perpetuo | complete this ganador to unlock Dictator Perpetuo
Two-horned Great King | complete this ganador to unlock Two-horned Great King
